name: beautiful-nodejs
description: Write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic Node.js + TypeScript: three skills distilled from the Google TypeScript Style Guide, Effective TypeScript, Node.js Best Practices, TypeScript Deep Dive, and the facta backend-node handbook, plus a drop-in eslint config.

interface.longDescription:
Three skills for Node.js + TypeScript developers, distilled from the Google TypeScript Style Guide, Effective TypeScript, Node.js Best Practices, TypeScript Deep Dive, and the facta backend-node handbook.

nodejs-best-practices guides new Node.js and TypeScript code: the strict tsconfig set, discriminated unions and branded ids that make invalid states unrepresentable, async discipline on the event loop, the one-error-envelope error path, BullMQ outbox for durable work, Drizzle with paired schema and migrations, Pino for structured logging, and the unbreakable hexagonal + vertical-slicing architecture contract.

nodejs-review reviews a file, a slice, a module, or a diff and returns a prioritized report. A broken architecture contract ranks above everything. Every finding cites a file and line, the rule it breaks, and the smallest fix.

nodejs-port ports Python, Go, Rust, C, or legacy JavaScript to idiomatic TypeScript with the same behavior. It ports the original tests first and writes a PORTING.md that lists every deliberate difference.

The skills contain instructions and reference text only. They make no network calls and collect no data. When a Node.js toolchain is available, the skills run tsc, eslint, and vitest on your project; without one, they work from the code alone. A drop-in eslint config is available in the GitHub repository.
capabilities: Review Node.js code with cited rules
Port code to TypeScript with the same behavior
defaultPrompt: Review this TypeScript service and list what to fix first
Port this Python module to idiomatic TypeScript
Write a Fastify route with validation and typed errors

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three skills for Node.js + TypeScript with a proven eslint config.
